known.summary: `isStrictlyInside` refuses only a relative path that starts with `../`. The relative path from a root to its parent folder is exactly `..`, so the parent counts as inside the root. `removeTemporaryPath` then removes recursively, for example, `~/.cache/docks-kit`, the parent of the scratch root, with the whole kit cache and every other scratch folder: a removal outside every allowed root (CWE-22, path traversal). `docks-kit scratch remove` and the agent tools take this path from an agent. The pull request adds scratch.ts: the base has no such file and no scratch removal.
